categories.main_business_segments: US Foods operates as a single business segment focused on marketing, selling, and distributing fresh, frozen, and dry food and non-food products to foodservice customers across the United States. The company manages its operations as one integrated network, leveraging standardized processes and shared infrastructure to serve a diverse customer base through broadline distribution and cash-and-carry retail outlets.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: US Foods relies on a nationwide logistics and distribution network, including over 70 distribution facilities, a fleet of more than 6,500 trucks, and over 90 cash-and-carry locations. The company utilizes the MOXē digital platform for customer ordering and analytics, and offers value-added services such as menu design and business tools. It sources products from thousands of suppliers and operates some processing facilities for meat, poultry, seafood, and produce.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves approximately 250,000 customer locations, including independent restaurants, regional and national restaurant chains, healthcare institutions, hospitality businesses, educational organizations, and government entities. Its primary focus is on independent restaurants, healthcare, and hospitality customers, which are considered higher-margin and more likely to purchase private label products.
categories.geographic_coverage: US Foods operates exclusively in the United States, with distribution and retail facilities in nearly every state. Its network includes 74 distribution centers and 93 cash-and-carry locations, providing comprehensive national coverage with local execution.
categories.supply_chain_position: US Foods functions as a downstream distributor in the foodservice supply chain, purchasing finished goods from suppliers and delivering them to end customers such as restaurants, healthcare facilities, and other institutions. It also operates some processing and repacking facilities for select product categories.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategic priorities center on its 'WE HELP YOU MAKE IT™' brand promise, emphasizing quality products (including exclusive and private brands), digital tools (MOXē platform), expert support, and flexible delivery options. Innovation is driven by programs like Scoop™ (on-trend product launches) and Serve Good® (sustainably sourced products), with ongoing investments in technology, operational efficiency, and selective acquisitions to expand reach and capabilities.
categories.revenue_model: US Foods generates revenue primarily through the sale and distribution of food and non-food products to foodservice customers. Revenue is recognized upon delivery of goods, with additional income from value-added services and private label product sales. The company also operates cash-and-carry retail outlets for smaller or price-conscious customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: US Foods is one of the largest broadline foodservice distributors in the U.S., competing with national, regional, and local distributors such as Sysco, Performance Food Group, and Gordon Food Service, as well as specialty distributors, cash-and-carry retailers, and wholesale clubs. The company differentiates itself through its national scale, exclusive brands, technology offerings, and value-added services.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In fiscal year 2024, US Foods reported net sales of $37.9 billion, a 6.4% increase over the prior year, with gross profit of $6.5 billion and net income of $494 million. The company has demonstrated steady growth in sales and case volume, particularly among independent restaurant and healthcare customers, and maintains significant liquidity and access to capital markets.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: US Foods emphasizes its ability to deliver quality, breadth of assortment, and innovative exclusive brands, supported by digital tools and expert consulting to help customers operate more efficiently and profitably. Its omni-channel approach, including broadline delivery, cash-and-carry, and direct-to-customer specialty products, provides flexibility and convenience, while its private label offerings and sustainability programs address evolving consumer and customer preferences.
